subject.title: fix(github-copilot): preserve reasoning during tool calls

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the narrower GitHub Copilot contract: preserve complete encrypted reasoning only during the same active Responses tool loop, while stripping it from every restored replay history?
rationale: The branch is technically focused and proof-positive, but it deliberately changes the scope of a recently merged provider safety policy; source review alone cannot establish the intended long-term compatibility contract for all supported Copilot Responses models.

options.title: Adopt the active-versus-restored split
options.body: Accept the provider-local lifecycle distinction and land the PR with the existing focused regressions and live proof.

options.title: Keep broad stripping
options.body: Retain the current main behavior if the provider contract cannot guarantee that active-loop ciphertext remains valid across every supported continuation.

recommendation.title: Adopt the active-versus-restored split
recommendation.body: Accept the provider-local lifecycle distinction and land the PR with the existing focused regressions and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the merged payload-sanitization policy that the PR narrows, making them the closest history-based routing candidate.
